contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and FND-0109 does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5 so (6,6) needs new geometry) and with the packet C66-GEO-Z / C66-COMP-RANK bottleneck. Arithmetic of the stated codimension is correct for ambient dim M_{6,6}=21: image dimension dim B+2 has codimension 19-dim B. Setup degrees match SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6: deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f so for g=6,f=5 deg W_5=16 and deg L=deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6 with χ(L)=1. Independent mathematical check: if AJ_B≅P(p_*L_B) is a P^2-bundle over B (constant h^0=3), then dim AJ_B=dim B+2, but the reduced-support locus U_red is only an open of that bundle; on any irreducible component an open has the ambient dimension if and only if it is nonempty. Fixed non-reduced parts of a linear system can empty the reduced-support open over a component even when the full Abel–Jacobi fibre/Sym^6 fibre is nonempty. Classical Bertini only guarantees that a general member is smooth away from the base locus, so it does not free a dim(im U_red)=dim B+2 claim from a nonemptiness/denseness hypothesis when base locus or fixed non-reduced part may intervene. SRC-0004 itself records that evaluation-surjective opens in related CE/Hurwitz constructions are open and a priori may be empty. Corroborated packet support: FND-0083 (RR proves only full AJ fibre nonempty, not reduced-support open / Conf_6 on every geometric fibre); FND-0101 (asserting a clause while recording a high-severity gap against it is not weakest-sufficient); FND-0058/FND-0047/FND-0107 (P^2 / Proj identification needs constant h^0); FND-0052 (reduced-support relative linear system is only an open piece of failure). FND-0005 is compatible: it gives total-space nonemptiness of Z/full |L| and at most total-space nonemptiness of U_red as the base varies; that does not discharge componentwise denseness of U_red needed to upgrade dim AJ_B=dim B+2 into dim(im U_red)=dim B+2. Relation: FND-0109 specializes FND-0083 to image-dimension and instantiates FND-0101 for ATT-0063 theorem part (G) versus GAP-RANK-BPF, but is not a pure duplicate—its load-bearing COMP-RANK content is that P^2-bundle plus geometric-point injectivity alone do not yield the dim B+2 image clause. ATT-0063 text is absent from the read-only workspace so the textual (G)/GAP-RANK-BPF conflict is accepted as review-sourced process provenance in the same way prior FAUDs treated missing attempt artifacts; the geometric obstruction stands independently. Promote candidate to corroborated; merge_target none; do not merge into FND-0083 (would lose the dim-image formulation) or FND-0101 (would lose geometry).
